name: Line volleys without stepping in
summary: At the non-volley-zone line, volley soft feeds back to a partner without a foot touching the line or the zone; count your own faults.
setup: Volleyer stands with both toes just behind the non-volley-zone line; feeder stands at the opposite non-volley-zone line in the same half
Feeder tosses or pats soft, high balls to the volleyer's forehand and backhand; the volleyer volleys them back softly without letting them bounce

After each volley the volleyer checks the feet: a foot on the line or in the zone during or right after the volley counts as an own fault (play it as your rules allow; the fault rules are UNVERIFIED in this app)
Sets of 20 volleys; swap roles after each set
success_criterion: In each of 2 sets of 20 volleys, at most 1 own fault (foot on the line or in the zone)
coach_rationale: (judgment) Faults at the line (a foot in the non-volley zone on a volley, tagged `nvz` or `foot`) end rallies with no opponent shot, which is what the AN-07 fault share counts; soft cooperative feeds let a beginner fix the balance and the stop after the volley first. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
